errors.evidence: The X-axes are not labeled "Внос" (Imports) and "Износ" (Exports). These are labels for the two subplots. The X-axis in both plots represents the years from 2004 to 2019.

errors.text_span: На левия график, който представя вноса, плътната линия „Общо” започва около 12% през 2004 г., нараства до около 40% през 2010 г., след което намалява до около 25% през 2016 г.
errors.evidence: The values for the 'Общо' (Total) line in the left plot are incorrect. It starts at approximately 15% (not 12%), peaks at about 42% in 2012 (not 40% in 2010), and its value in 2016 is approximately 30% (not 25%).

errors.evidence: The values for the 'EC' (EU) line in the left plot are incorrect. It starts at approximately 10% (not under 10%), peaks at about 28% (not 25%), and ends at about 23% (not 20%).
